equation.exposition_role: Reference inference rule for addition of same-currency monetary expressions.
equation.symbols_units_domain: x and y are expressions; C is their currency parameter; the conclusion retains Money<C>.
equation.assumptions_timing: Both operands have the displayed type; observation-context compatibility is separate. Explicit conversions require dated measurement, rate and purpose.
equation.source_and_equality: A locally specified typing rule, not an imported accounting identity or a financial amount equality.
equation.interpretation: Adding two amounts in one currency preserves that currency; a different currency does not satisfy the premises.
equation.transition: Leads to symbolic arithmetic, nonzero-denominator requirements and logical query semantics on378.

equation.exposition_role: Exact set definition for operational rule precedence.
equation.symbols_units_domain: V is the applicable rule set for event e and concrete history h; r and r-prime are rules and precedes denotes valid override, with no monetary units.
equation.assumptions_timing: Package/date and guard selection precede this operation; overrides use the declared acyclic graph.
equation.source_and_equality: Local definitional equality: membership means applicability and absence of an applicable overriding rule.
equation.interpretation: One maximal rule selects; none yields UnsupportedTreatment; more than one yields RuleConflict for a required recognition operation.
equation.transition: The evaluator then checks bindings, balance and restrictions before an atomic commit.
